items.prompt: Repaint the supplied NovelAI storyboard for 受缚之残影 into our approved rough hand-painted anime card style. Image1 COMPOSITION authority: preserve the male mage's low-angle kneeling pose, knee in lower right, torso leaning back, one gloved arm raised toward upper-right narrow light opening, face following his hand, other hand near hip, long cloak trailing toward lower left. Image2 is EXCLUSIVE identity: adult male Chang Wuyu, recognizable refined young masculine face, silver-gray LOW BUN and long sidelocks, restrained golden eyes behind thin round glasses, pointed ears, black bent-tip wide brim hat/purple lining, black high-collared robe/purple lining/gold edges, black gloves and boots, WHITE FEATHER with BLUE SAPPHIRE GOLD CLASP on his LEFT CHEST. Never turn him into a girl or old rugged man; do not copy Image2 standing pose or fireball. Image3 STYLE ONLY: opaque broad color masses, handmade hard light-shadow shapes, economical directional swipes and selective face/hand detail; no girl/flower props imported. DESIGN refinement: depict captivity through his SHADOW. Replace tiny fine chain strings with two or three enormous broad readable chain sections crossing the nearest foreground diagonally. They pin the elongated flat cloak-shaped shadow at lower left, while the real kneeling man reaches oppositely into the light. The shadow is a flat dark paint mass, not a second person. Keep raised glove readable without tangling many tiny chains around fingers. Preserve the light opening and the opposing diagonal layout; abstract quiet light/dark backdrop without a literal room, detailed ground or decorative particles. Group hair into large locks, cloth into principal fold planes, chains into simple dark and light faces with few marks. Matte subdued blue-gray/violet masses, concentrated ivory light; no smooth glossy cloth, fine hair strands, dense wrinkles, facet mosaics, oil impasto or texture filter. Single square, no text/frame/UI/watermark.
